sweep.notes: Sponsor-only directory (NASCIO has no exhibit hall), 8 tiers: Pinnacle 2, Networking Hub 2, WiFi 1, Headshot Lounge 1, Give Back 6, Gold 32, Silver 20, Bronze 12 = 76. No pagination. Discovery note said ~80; actual is 76. curl returned 403 even with the Chrome UA and full header set, so I used WebFetch plus live-DOM extraction in the browser. Guard against a summarizer bug: WebFetch reported bogus totals ('98 companies', 'Gold 33') while its own name list held 76 -- I enumerated headings and logo alts directly from the DOM to confirm exactly 8 tiers and 76 names, matching WebFetch name-for-name. Names come from logo alt text; the only links on the page are nascio.org member-directory profiles, not company sites, so the website field holds each company's real canonical domain rather than a NASCIO profile URL. Classification: excluded integrators/consultancies (Accenture, Deloitte, EY, McKinsey, Capgemini, NTT DATA, SAIC, GDIT, Peraton, Unisys, Slalom, TekStream, Egen, Nava), named resellers (Carahsoft, SHI, CDW-G, Presidio, WWT), analysts (Gartner, Forrester), accounting firms (BerryDunn, RSM), hardware makers (Dell, AMD, HPE, Yubico), telecoms (AT&T, Verizon, T-Mobile, Comcast, Spectrum), services (TTEC, Luna Data, Optum).
